_note: Recording names (without extension) in capture_dir: full run, drawing run, collaboration run (owner) and the client's browser. After a new capture, put its names here and run prep_footage.py, then build.py.
_marks_note: Optional moments inside a step, found by looking at the footage: 'all checks pass' = the frame where the plan's status card turns to 'Fixed … → 0'; '3d code' = when it says 'Building the 3D model…'. Without them build.py derives them from 'house view'.
